question: Which para-archer achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first in their discipline to be honoured with the Padma Shri in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harvinder Singh** scripted history in **2025** by becoming the **first-ever para-archer** from India to be conferred with the **Padma Shri**, the nation's fourth-highest civilian award.
 
• This recognition came after his monumental achievement at the **Paris 2024 Paralympic Games**, where he won the **Gold medal** in the **Men's Individual Recurve Open** category.
 
• His victory in **Paris** was particularly significant as it marked **India's first-ever gold medal** in archery at either the **Olympic** or **Paralympic Games**.
 
• Prior to his 2024 success, Singh had already established himself as a pioneer by winning a **Bronze medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games**, which was the first-ever Paralympic medal for India in the discipline of archery.
 
• The **Government of India** announced this honor on the eve of the **76th Republic Day** in **January 2025**, recognizing his exceptional contribution to sports and his role in elevating the profile of para-archery in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Para-Archers:**
 
 
• **Rakesh Kumar** is a world-class para-archer who won a **Bronze medal** in the **Mixed Team Compound** event at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics** alongside **Sheetal Devi**.
 
• **Jyoti Balyan** is a prominent female para-archer who represented **India** at the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics** and has won several medals at the **Asian Para Games** and **World Championships**.
 
• **Vivek Chikara** is an accomplished recurve archer who won a **Gold medal** at the **2019 Asian Para Archery Championships** and reached the quarterfinals at the **Tokyo Paralympics**.
 
 
 
• **Harvinder Singh's Career Milestones:**
 
 
• He won a **Gold medal** at the **2018 Asian Para Games** held in **Jakarta**, which was a turning point in his international career.
 
• He also secured a **Bronze medal** at the **2022 Asian Para Games** (held in **2023**) in **Hangzhou**, **China**.
 
• In **2021**, he was bestowed with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor, for his outstanding performance in the **Tokyo Paralympics**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Personal Background:** **Harvinder Singh** hails from **Kaithal, Haryana**. Despite facing physical challenges due to a **dengue** treatment side effect in his childhood that affected his legs, he pursued both sports and academics with excellence.
 
• **Academic Excellence:** He is not only a top-tier athlete but also a highly educated individual, holding a **Ph.D. in Economics** from **Punjabi University, Patiala**.
 
• **Padma Awards 2025:** The **Padma Shri** is awarded for "distinguished service" in any field. In **2025**, the list included several sportspersons, but Singh's inclusion was historic for the **archery community** in India, as no other archer (para or able-bodied) had previously reached this specific milestone within the para-discipline category for this award year.
